name: Chinese SafetyQA
description: Chinese SafetyQA is a benchmark designed to evaluate the factuality ability of large language models in answering short safety-related questions in Chinese. It focuses on assessing accuracy, comprehensiveness, and clarity in domains such as law, policy, and ethics to ensure safe and compliant deployment of LLMs.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with early-stage adoption, mainly cited as a Chinese safety and factuality evaluation set rather than a widely established standard.
notes: Focuses on Chinese language, safety-related factuality, and short-form questions; emphasizes ease of evaluation and harmlessness.
